    • Method Detail

      • createTask

        public Task createTask​(Task task)
                throws java.sql.SQLException
        Inserts a task and writes its generated ID back to the same object. This layer does not check session permissions.
        Parameters:
        task - task whose creator and optional assignee are persisted users
        Returns:
        the supplied task with its generated ID
        Throws:
        java.lang.IllegalArgumentException - if task is null or a referenced user ID is not positive
        java.sql.SQLException - if database access fails, including a foreign-key violation

      • findById

        public Task findById​(int taskId)
              throws java.sql.SQLException
        Looks up a task by database ID.
        Parameters:
        taskId - identifier to look up
        Returns:
        matching task, or null if absent
        Throws:
        java.sql.SQLException - if database access fails

      • findRelevantTasks

        public java.util.List<Task> findRelevantTasks​(int userId)
                                       throws java.sql.SQLException
        Loads tasks created by or assigned to a user without checking session permissions.
        Parameters:
        userId - user identifier to match
        Returns:
        tasks ordered open first, then by ID; possibly empty; no duplicates for self-assignment
        Throws:
        java.sql.SQLException - if database access fails

      • updateTask

        public boolean updateTask​(Task task)
                   throws java.sql.SQLException
        Stores task details and completion state while preserving stored creator ownership. This layer does not check session permissions.
        Parameters:
        task - task with a positive ID and persisted creator and optional assignee
        Returns:
        true if one row was updated; false if the ID was not found
        Throws:
        java.lang.IllegalArgumentException - if task is null, its ID is not positive, or a referenced user ID is not positive
        java.sql.SQLException - if database access fails, including a foreign-key violation

      • assignTask

        public boolean assignTask​(int taskId,
                          User assignee)
                   throws java.sql.SQLException
        Stores assignment without checking session permissions.
        Parameters:
        taskId - database task identifier
        assignee - persisted user, or null to unassign
        Returns:
        true if one row was changed; false if the ID was not found
        Throws:
        java.lang.IllegalArgumentException - if the supplied assignee ID is not positive
        java.sql.SQLException - if database access fails, including a foreign-key violation

      • markCompleted

        public boolean markCompleted​(int taskId,
                             boolean completed)

        Stores completion state without checking session permissions.
        Parameters:

        completed - true to complete; false to reopen
        Returns:
        true if one row was changed; false if the ID was not found
        Throws:
